beats.vo: You just scrolled past an ad. But before it reached you, an auction happened.
beats.head: Before this ad [o]reached you...[/o]

beats.vo: And it was over in about a tenth of a second.
beats.head: [g]~100 MILLISECONDS[/g]

beats.vo: At zero milliseconds, your app tells an ad system: a screen is free, and here's who is probably looking.
beats.head: [g]0 ms:[/g] a screen is free

beats.vo: Now AI models predict how likely you are to click, buy, or skip, for thousands of ads at once.
beats.head: AI predicts: [o]click? buy? skip?[/o]

beats.vo: Advertisers' systems bid. The best mix of price and predicted value wins.
beats.head: Best [g]value[/g] wins

beats.vo: Then the ad is shaped for you. This is personalisation.
beats.head: This is [c]personalisation.[/c]

beats.vo: In Meta's reported plan, the same car ad could show a snowy mountain to one person, and a city road to another.
beats.head: Same ad. [g]Different[/g] world.

beats.vo: India saw this early. In 2021, Cadbury used AI to recreate Shah Rukh Khan's face and voice, in ads for more than two thousand local stores.
beats.head: [g]2,000+[/g] local stores. One star.

beats.vo: At around a hundred milliseconds, the winning ad is on your screen.
beats.head: [g]100 ms:[/g] on your screen

beats.vo: Now multiply that by billions of scrolls, every single day.
beats.head: × [g]BILLIONS[/g] a day

beats.vo: That machine is why Meta said its AI powered ad tools passed a sixty billion dollar annual run rate, in 2025.
beats.head: [g]$60B+[/g] a year

beats.vo: And the reported goal: give it a product image and a budget, and AI builds the rest, by the end of 2026.
beats.head: Image + budget = [c]a whole ad[/c]

beats.vo: So who really runs your feed? The advertiser, or the algorithm?
beats.head: Advertiser or [o]algorithm?[/o]

beats.vo: And if you want to be the one running these machines, join AI and Advertising, by IdeaBro Studio. Link in bio.
beats.head: Join [g]AI & Advertising[/g]
